'''K-3PO''' was a [[3PO-series protocol droid|3PO]] [[protocol droid]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He was stationed at [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]], where he was charged with organizing the base's [[droid]]pool. He was destroyed due to falling debris when the Rebel command center sustained [[Galactic Empire|enemy]] fire during the [[Battle of Hoth]].

==Biography==
[[File:K-3PO_destroyed.jpg|thumb|left|200px|K-3PO was destroyed during the Battle of Hoth.]]
Manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica]],<ref name="Build R2-D2 17" /> K-3PO served in the [[Alliance Military|military]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> by the [[Standard year|year]] [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> The [[protocol droid]] worked in the military command center of [[Echo Base]] on the ice [[planet]] [[Hoth]], where it monitored troop movements, personally delivered messages, and also operated the loudspeaker announcement systems.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> He was also put in charge of organizing the Echo Base [[droid]]pool.<ref name="TESB40">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back: The 40th Anniversary Special Edition|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'': The 40th Anniversary Special Edition]]</ref>

K-3PO was monitoring a tactical screen when Captain [[Han Solo]] informed the [[General]], [[Carlist Rieekan]] of his intention to leave Rebellion and pay off his debt to the [[Hutt]]<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> [[crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba the Hutt">{{Databank|jabba-the-hutt|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. During the Imperial invasion of Hoth, the [[droid]] was present in the main command center when the Rebels lowered Echo Base's [[Deflector shield|shield]] and fired off the [[Battle of Hoth]]'s opening shots from Echo Base's<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> [[v-150 Planet Defender]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars2">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> [[ion cannon]], allowing their [[Quantum Storm|first]] [[transport]] to escape the [[orbit]]ing Imperial [[fleet]]. K-3PO was present when patrols were launched and any remaining ground staff were ordered to evacuate. However, the droid was destroyed by falling debris when the command center sustained damage from enemy fire before the [[Bright Hope|last Rebel transport]] departed Echo Base.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:PrissyAndPrissier-ST.jpg|thumb|300px|right|K-3PO and C-3PO were both stationed at Echo Base.]]
K-3PO was a [[3PO-series protocol droid|3PO]] protocol droid with [[Color|white]] plating and a pair of yellow<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> [[photoreceptor]]s.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> The droid stood 1.67 [[meter]]s in height<ref name="Height" /> and weighed 75 [[kilogram]]s.<ref name="Mass" /> A [[Rebel command insignia|pair of red pips]] were on the right side of his pectoral plating, indicating his rank of [[captain]].<ref name="Build R2-D2 17" /> K-3PO was proficient in over 8 million forms of communication,<ref name="Altaya">{{EncyclopediaCite|C-3PO}}</ref> and the droid's [[memory bank]]s were full of battle tactics.<ref name="Updated and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
K-3PO first appeared in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> where it was portrayed by [[Chris Parsons]], who was also a stand-in for [[Anthony Daniels]] as [[C-3PO]] and played [[4-LOM]].<ref name="K-3PO">{{DB|droid|k3po|K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)}}</ref> The droid was first identifed by the form of an action figure released by Japanese toy company [[Kotobukiya]] in [[April]] [[2015]].<ref name="KOTOBUKIYA">{{KotoCite|set=ARTFX+|pack=R3-A2 with K-3PO CELEBRATION EXCLUSIVE|url=https://www.kotobukiya.co.jp/product/detail/p4934054902408}}</ref> The name K-3PO was originally created for the [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|second edition]] of ''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', a [[1996]] supplement written by [[Michael Stern]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', which [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]]<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> the "Coordinator Droid" that first appeared in [[National Public Radio|NPR's]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio dramatization]],<ref name="Radio">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref> first broadcast on [[February 14]], [[1983]],<ref name="The National Public Radio Dramatization">[[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''The Empire Strikes Back'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref> into being one and the same as Chris Parsons' protocol droid extra.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3" />
